name: emby-watchparty-legacy
description: LEGACY Flask+SocketIO build of emby-watchparty (v1.6.x, single shared HLS stream). Pinned to the `:legacy` image tag, which tracks the `legacy` branch (formerly `main`, republished after the 2.0 cutover). New deployments should install the current `emby-watchparty` template (Vue 3 + FastAPI, per-user streams, admin panel). This template exists so existing users can keep their v1.x install running while the 2.0 series takes over `:latest`. A synchronized watch party application for Emby media servers -- all HLS is proxied through the container so your Emby server can stay on your internal network.

paths.name: ENV File Path (optional)
paths.description: Optional: mount a .env file into the container. If set, values in this file will be used. Individual env vars above take precedence.

paths.name: App Config Directory
paths.description: Path on the host where emby-watchparty will store any persistent config or state.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the emby-watchparty web interface.

variables.name: Emby Server URL
variables.description: Full URL to your Emby server, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8096

variables.name: Emby API Key
variables.description: Your Emby API key. Generate one in Emby Dashboard > Advanced > API Keys.

variables.name: Emby Username
variables.description: Emby username used to authenticate and proxy HLS streams.

variables.name: Emby Password
variables.description: Password for the Emby user above.

variables.name: App Prefix
variables.description: URL prefix for reverse proxy deployments (e.g. /watchparty). Leave empty for root deployment.

variables.name: Require Login
variables.description: Require Emby login to access the web UI (true/false). Leave false for open guest access.

variables.name: Session Expiry (seconds)
variables.description: Session expiry in seconds. Default 86400 (24 hours).

variables.name: Static Session Enabled
variables.description: Keep a single persistent party alive across restarts (true/false). Users navigating to / are redirected straight into the party.

variables.name: Static Session ID
variables.description: Fixed party ID used when Static Session Enabled is true. Uppercase.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR.

variables.name: Console Log Level
variables.description: Log level for stdout/console output. Default WARNING keeps Docker logs quiet.

variables.name: Log To File
variables.description: Set to false (recommended for Docker) to output logs to stdout only. Set to true to write logs to a file inside the container.

variables.name: Log File Path
variables.description: Path to the log file inside the container. Only used when Log To File is true.

variables.name: Log Max Size (MB)
variables.description: Maximum size of the log file in megabytes before rotation.

variables.name: Max Users Per Party
variables.description: Maximum users per watch party. 0 means unlimited.

variables.name: Enable HLS Token Validation
variables.description: Validate HLS stream tokens so only party members can fetch segments (true/false).

variables.name: HLS Token Expiry (seconds)
variables.description: How long HLS tokens remain valid, in seconds. Default 86400 (24 hours).

variables.name: Enable Rate Limiting
variables.description: Enable per-IP rate limiting on API endpoints (true/false).

variables.name: Rate Limit: Party Creations Per Hour
variables.description: Maximum party creations per IP per hour.

variables.name: Rate Limit: API Calls Per Minute
variables.description: Maximum API calls per IP per minute.
